h: Brackenwall Village: kill these as you meet them

l.x: Head west back across the marsh. The Darkfang Venomspitters on the ridges north of Brackenwall drop the venom sacs. Theramore Infiltrators (35-36) sneak through the same woods: they are stealthed, so look closely. The Darkmist spiders swarm the cavern mouth north-west of Brackenwall; every kind drops eyes. Careful: Darkfang Lurkers (level 36-37) use Sneak to stealth while out of combat and cast Poison once fighting. Careful: Stealthed spiders in the same area will attack you on sight. Careful: Darkmist Lurkers move about stealthed and use poison once in combat. The spiders stand close together, so adds are common; pulling single targets from the outer edge cuts down on them.
Récupérez 6 × Sac de venin acide
Récupérez 40 × Oeil de Sombrebrume sur Araignée de Sombrebrume

Head north-east to the Valley of Spears. Melizza Brimbuzzle is held in the Maraudine centaur camp; free her and escort her out east of the valley. Careful: The scripted groups are linked and only appear during the escort, so you cannot clear them in advance or pull them one at a time. Clearing the normal centaurs on the path before you start does help.
